WITH registered_provider AS (
            INSERT INTO billing_gateway_provider_rate_limits (
                provider_key,
                rate_limited_until
            )
            VALUES ($1, '-infinity')
            ON CONFLICT (provider_key) DO NOTHING
        )
        INSERT INTO billing_gateway_accounts (
            id,
            billing_scope_id,
            provider_key,
            gateway_configuration_id
        )
        VALUES ($2, $3, $1, $4)
